Wine tourism · Roussillon · South of France

Natural wine tasting & cellar visit near Perpignan

Visit the cellar of an organic and natural winery in Latour-de-France, in the Agly Valley, and taste 4 to 8 wines with the winemaker. 1 h 30, €3 per person, in English, French or Spanish.

Check availability

An authentic visit at the winemaker's

Domaine de Sabbat is a family winery of 11 hectares founded in 2008 by Sylvain Lejeune. The vines grow on schist, marl and clay-limestone soils around Maury, Tautavel and Vingrau, at the foot of the Corbières hills. During the visit you discover the cellar and the principles of natural winemaking: no chemical inputs, respect for the grape, the soil and living things.

The tasting covers a selection of Côtes du Roussillon, Côtes du Roussillon Villages, I.G.P. Côtes Catalanes, natural wines and Rivesaltes, depending on the day.

At a glance

  • Duration: 1 h 30
  • Price: €3 per person
  • Group size: 1 to 20 people
  • Languages: English, French, Spanish
  • Wine available to buy on site

Address: 24 boulevard Carnot, 66720 Latour-de-France — directions (in French). Also available as a gift card.

Frequently asked questions

How long is the cellar visit and wine tasting?

About 1 hour 30. You taste between 4 and 8 natural and organic wines with the winemaker.

How much does it cost?

€3 per person, shown in the booking module.

Which languages are available?

The visit is offered in French, English and Spanish, for 1 to 20 people per slot.

Where is the winery?

24 boulevard Carnot, 66720 Latour-de-France, in the Agly Valley, about 20 km north-west of Perpignan (Pyrénées-Orientales, Roussillon, South of France).

Can I cancel my booking?

Yes, cancellation is possible up to 1 day before the visit.
